svg.aria-label: Digital Information System, built twice. The same dissertation upload runs through a Django monolith with a Celery worker and through six services linked by a RabbitMQ content.created event. When one process dies, the monolith loses all five features and the split build loses only uploads. The cost of the split: six deployables instead of one, three languages instead of one, six data stores instead of three.
